normalization_notes: Municipal 명륜동2가 and 명륜동 4가 normalize to MOIS 명륜2가 and 명륜4가.
Whitespace and comma vs period separators in administrative dong labels normalize to MOIS spelling.
Municipal 세종로1번지 is legal dong 세종로 with a parcel-specific note, not a separate legal dong.

honesty_rules: Membership is geography, not proof of delivery service, local shop ownership, availability or time guarantee.
Do not create one article per legal or administrative dong merely to reach these counts.
Use many-to-many membership, never flatten 세종로, 와룡동, 창신동 or 숭인동 to a single admin dong.
Resolve parcel-level administrative dong from full destination address when required.
Do not silently erase the MOIS 혜화동–와룡동 membership omitted by municipal summary.
